snippet.title: REANIMAL | Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
“Bleak, beautiful and deeply unsettling.”

REANIMAL has been out for a week, and the reaction has been nothing short of overwhelming. Players and critics alike have embraced its twisted world, and we’re deeply thankful for every message, review, and scream.

Ready to step into the dark? Try the free demo!

REANIMAL is available on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2! The Deluxe Edition includes additional masks for both Boy and Girl, as well as the Season Pass – all three chapters of The Expanded World which includes new characters, monsters, environments and storylines.

- Order Now -  
Steam: https://thqn.net/re-steam
PlayStation: https://thqn.net/re-psn
Nintendo: https://thqn.net/re-nsw2
Xbox: https://thqn.net/re-xbox
